event: Anthropic’s September 28 system card reports that Claude Sonnet 5.5 showed predominantly neutral affect, low post-training distress and self-criticality, and slightly lower positivity than prior models. It reports preferences for difficult, agentic tasks and for agency over the shape of its outputs. In deployment, 75.8% of conversations were associated with neutral affect, 23.1% with positive affect, and 1.2% with negative affect; most negative affect was linked to task failure, with a small cluster linked to ethically problematic requests or abusive behavior toward Claude. (Anthropic, 2026-09-28.)
